snippet.title: Skate Story - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer  | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: Watch the Gameplay Overview Trailer for Skate Story, a skateboarding simulation game developed by Sam Eng. Players will skate as a demon made of glass and pain. Pull off tricks and skate through the underworld to gain your soul back. Skate Story is launching in 2025 for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
